items.title: Learner ID access is ready
items.detail: Learners register with an email address, receive one account-level Learner ID on screen, and use both to sign in. No Learner ID email is sent.

items.title: Thirteen seven-week starter pathways are available
items.detail: The current catalogue covers coding, visual work, and practical AI with weekly study, guided practice, independent variation, review, and saved evidence.

items.title: Weekly learning checks are now five questions
items.detail: Each completed week has a protected five-question quiz, while every course ends with one backend-scored 40-question final exam.
